collection: Finance operations: patterns for documents, approvals, and explanations
review_scope: Inspected all eight complete question objects, required-state fields, criteria, code-owned responsibilities, follow-up limits, verification recipes, source notes, frozen fixtures, stored Jev receipts, and pattern pages.
Replayed the collection evaluator and reviewed existing source-support and 72-pair overlap-screen receipts instead of repeating satisfactory calls.

Confirmed the finance subtree contains catalogs, synthetic fixtures, receipt evaluators, tests, and documentation but no consuming application or required-field preflight. A Python-source search for a Jev client or preflight returned no matches; the complete file inventory contains only JSON, Markdown, and Python files.

The five public-source checks date from 2026-09-23. Four were recorded unchanged; the Net D page was noted as changed since its saved record. These sources motivate the patterns and do not establish Jev performance or current finance guidance.

source_support.changed_source_note: FN-S3 (Net D) was recorded as changed since its prior source record; the saved excerpt still supported the design summary. This wave did not live-refresh it because the page motivates a text-reading example and is not relied on as current finance guidance.

page_claim_wording.reason: The eight finance pages contained the same original and revised missing-field gate sentences already judged in the prior legal-contract wave; this wording probe was not repeated.

FN07.approval_request: Approve $4,800 for replacement field testers under the operating budget by Friday.
FN07.approver_message: I can approve the $4,800 once the controller confirms funds are available. Hold the order until that confirmation.

FN08.bank_memo: CORVANE SOFTWARE LTD - SECURITY DEPOSIT OFFICE SUBLET Q4
FN08.expected_purpose: Outgoing payment to Corvane Software Ltd for the annual platform licence renewal, our reference INV-EX-512; the ledger codes it to software subscriptions.

host_disposition.FN07: The tested reply makes approval contingent on a named approver's funds confirmation. The written distinction between an approval subject to a condition and a decision that is not yet made supports conditional_approval for this case. The low-confidence historical pair signal does not establish a contract defect; preserve FN07 v1.
host_disposition.FN08: The tested memo names the same counterparty but a different transaction purpose. The instruction states that a purpose of a different kind is inconsistent, and the frozen FN08-4 challenge tests this boundary. Jev's label confidence was moderate, but it found the instruction supplies the conflict rule. No question or fixture change is justified by the screening signal alone; preserve FN08 v1.

advisory_reviews.boundary: Advisory semantic review only. The supplied expected labels were not included. It does not establish accuracy in use or a real reconciliation/approval outcome.

outcome.confirmed_documentation_defect: All eight pages claimed a deterministic missing-field gate already ran, although this collection contains no consumer or preflight implementation.
outcome.repair: Reworded all eight pages to prescribe the gate for future consumer code and state that this collection does not implement or verify it. Added a regression requiring exact embedded-question parity and this boundary wording on all pages.
outcome.reason: The 32 frozen cases still replay 32/32. Host review of the FN07 and FN08 overlap leads found their existing instructions adequate for the supplied cases; no question or expectation was changed to fit Jev output.
outcome.integration_follow_up: Before using any finance label, a consumer must enforce required fields in code, keep amount/date/matching and approval decisions deterministic, and verify against independently labeled workflow outcomes.
